name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-news
title: Google News — FlashData
description: Google News articles with publishers, date labels and links for topic briefs. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_news access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Build a source-linked Google News topic digest
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].news and group entries by source. Keep title, link, source, date and snippet; preserve relative date labels rather than inventing absolute publication times.
dev.flashdata.limits: This call reads one news snapshot. Scheduling and delivering a recurring digest belong to your application. It does not retrieve article full text.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
